post.summary: Book ONE directed trip for a service date (Student only)
post.description:
Create the student's booking on one OUTBOUND or RETURN trip.

Requires an ACTIVE subscription covering the requested date. One OUTBOUND
and one RETURN booking are allowed per service date. The selected point
must be one of the trip's stops. On OUTBOUND the student's registered
university is automatically the destination; on RETURN the selected point
is the destination.

StudentTripViewResponse.title: StudentTripViewResponse
StudentTripViewResponse.description:
Student-facing trip view with dynamic destination and booking state.

SubscriptionCreateRequest.title: SubscriptionCreateRequest
SubscriptionCreateRequest.description:
Payload for a student purchasing a subscription plan.

INTENTIONALLY plan-only: plan + start date + payment method (+ digital
payment reference for digital methods). There is NO route_id, trip_id, or
pickup-point field — daily transportation is selected separately through
the daily reservation workflow.

SubscriptionDetailResponse.title: SubscriptionDetailResponse
SubscriptionDetailResponse.description:
Extended subscription representation with usage statistics.

Weekly fields are DAYS, not QR scans: usage_days_this_week counts DISTINCT
calendar dates with any successful scan (Mon-Sun, UTC); outbound + return
scans on the same date count as ONE usage day.

plan_type.description: Plan duration type (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, TERM)

duration_days.title: Duration Days
duration_days.description: Validity in calendar days (CEO-defined, all plan types). Examples: DAILY=30 with days_per_week=1 (flexible single-day weekly usage over a 30-day window), WEEKLY=7, MONTHLY=30 or 45, TERM=90 or 120.

days_per_week.title: Days Per Week
days_per_week.description: Maximum DISTINCT usage days per calendar week (Mon-Sun, UTC). Outbound + return on the same day count as ONE usage day. For DAILY plans this caps how many days per week the student may select transportation.

SubscriptionPlanCreate.title: SubscriptionPlanCreate
SubscriptionPlanCreate.description:
Schema for creating a new subscription plan (CEO only).

duration_days: calendar days the subscription stays valid (inclusive of
the start date). days_per_week: maximum DISTINCT usage days per calendar
week (Mon-Sun, UTC) — outbound + return scans on the same day count as ONE
usage day. These values are snapshotted onto subscriptions at purchase so
later plan edits never change an active student's behavior.

DAILY is FLEXIBLE: duration_days is the CEO-defined validity window and
days_per_week limits how many transportation days per week the student
may select via daily reservations. DAILY is NOT pinned to 1 day — every
plan type uses the same CEO-defined bounds.

passenger_capacity.title: Passenger Capacity
passenger_capacity.description: Optional capacity override (defaults to bus capacity if not set)

allow_overbooking.title: Allow Overbooking
allow_overbooking.description: When False and capacity is reached, the trip becomes FULL for new bookings. When True, extra bookings follow the existing overbooking rules.

TripCreateRequest.title: TripCreateRequest
TripCreateRequest.description:
Schema for scheduling a new trip (CEO only).

The CEO picks a route, then selects an ordered subset of that route's
pickup points with a scheduled departure time per stop. The trip-level
departure/arrival are derived from the first/last stop times, so a
ticket price and fixed destination do not exist here.

TripDirection.title: TripDirection
TripDirection.description:
Direction of a scheduled trip, chosen explicitly by the CEO.

OUTBOUND (ذهاب): student's pickup point → the student's registered
university (per-student, never stored on the trip).
RETURN (عودة): the university → the student's selected drop-off point.

TripResponse.title: TripResponse

TripStatus.description: Operational status of a scheduled trip.

pickup_point_id.description: Pickup point ID (must belong to the trip's route)

stop_order.title: Stop Order
stop_order.description: Explicit visiting order of this stop on the trip

departure_time.title: Departure Time
departure_time.description: Scheduled departure datetime for this stop
